label: copy-phase input u (fed-back original token at index >= 2)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase when the fed-back input token is u, i.e. the model just emitted original token u at position >= 2 (recall_idx >= 3). Never fires in the original phase, at <DEL>, or on any other input token (1 stray activation on 2). Very weak/rare at recall_idx 2 (rate 0.3%), so earlier positions are excluded; rate is flat ~3.4% of steps from recall_idx 3 onward (about 29-34% of copy-phase u inputs). Magnitude grows with position in the copy: low-quartile examples are u at the 3rd original position, top activations are u at original positions 5-7 near the end of long sequences. Not modulated by out_tok, prev_tok, first_tok or digit count.

issues: Test scores reproduce: P 0.965, R 0.978, F1 0.971, mass recall 0.996. Activations occur only in the copy phase (original and delimiter phases have 0 activations) and only on in_tok u, apart from one activation on '2'.

All 2017 test false positives fall at recall_idx == 3 (u from original position 2). There, precision is 0.878, compared with 1.0 for recall_idx >= 4. So the cutoff at index 2 is soft, not sharp. Precision at recall_idx 3 depends somewhat on L: about 0.98 for L 4-5, but 0.75-0.87 for L 6-8 and 0.92 for L 9. It does not depend on in_count, digit count, orig(0), orig(1) or orig(3) (precision 0.82-0.91 in every case), and there is no clean history class to carve out.
All 1275 missed activations are weak (0.03-0.18 of the max) u inputs at recall_idx 2, carrying 0.4% of the activation mass. This matches the explanation's claim of 'weak and rare at recall_idx 2'.
Alternative cutoffs score worse: recall_idx >= 4 gives F1 0.84 (P 1.0, R 0.72) and recall_idx >= 2 gives F1 0.87 (P 0.77, R 1.0). The stated predicate is the best simple choice.

Minor point: the label 'index >= 2' glosses over the fact that index-2 u is the weakest case and only about 88% reliable. The other claims check out in the profile: the rate is flat at about 3.4% from recall_idx 3 onward, which is about 100% of u steps since there are 30 tokens. Activation mass grows with recall_idx, and out_tok and prev_tok have no effect. The label does not overclaim.
